name: eterclack
description: Marketplace de servicios fotográficos — ETERnidad a un solo CLACK

scripts.reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d --build
scripts.db:migrate: docker compose exec api npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:push: docker compose exec api npx prisma db push
scripts.db:seed: docker compose exec api npm run seed
scripts.db:studio: docker compose exec api npx prisma studio --hostname 0.0.0.0
